device: iPhone 17 Pro / iOS 27.0 Simulator / Mac16,12 / Apple M4 / macOS 27.2
data: Fresh app container on isolated simulator; default first-run data; no production user data imported

size.kind: Local simulator .app ZIP; not an App Store IPA or device slice

idle.method: Shared measure.py: CPU time delta / 60s wall; 3 phys_footprint samples after CPU window, maximum reported
idle.scope: Simulator App process only; excludes CoreSimulator, Simulator GUI, system services and inactive extensions
idle.limitations: Post-launch simulator process sampling; simctl requested foreground by default; UIApplication/RunningBoard activation state was not observed and this is not a complete foreground business test.

speed_gui.label: 模拟器冷启动到首屏就绪
speed_gui.label_en: Simulator cold launch to first screen ready
speed_gui.method: Simulator unified log: CoreSimulator "Requesting launch of <bundle>" -> SpringBoard scene content state "ready" (app committed its first scene content) / FrontBoard "Dropping launch assertion" (launch finished). App process terminated 3 s before each run; system caches warm; first run after install discarded. Median of 5 runs. Reference on the same simulator: system Settings app 6816.5 ms to ready.
